items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 29:1
items.html: The vessels from the Chazeh downward of every Partzuf are called vessels of the back, and they are also called the vessels of the externality of the Partzuf. And these vessels of externality are themselves divided into front and back: the two lower thirds of Tifferet, from the Chazeh to the conclusion of Tifferet, are called the front of the externality, by reason of their being the discernment of the seven lower Sefirot of the Bina of the body; and therefore they still have a connection to the vessels of the interior, which are the HGT of the body. And the vessels of NHY are called the externality of the externality. And these front and back of the externality are called the two discernments of externality: from the discernment of the front of the externality was made the place of the world of Beriah, and from the discernment of the back of the externality were made the worlds of Yetzirah and Assiyah. (Item 3).
